retrievalProfile.description: A vertically symmetrical composition featuring a band lineup reflected across a central horizontal axis against a blue sky background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central horizontal line acts as a mirror plane for five figures dressed in white, set against a vibrant blue sky with soft white clouds. The top half is mirrored perfectly in the bottom half, creating a diamond-like cluster of figures.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures in white contrasting against deep blue
Text placed at the extreme top and bottom poles
Vertical OBI strip on the left margin
coreInvariants: Perfect vertical reflection of the central subject matter

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures arranged in a row, centered horizontally and vertically, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central horizontal axis where the real and reflected figures meet.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central band members, move upward to the top logo, then downward to the mirrored logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive blue sky surrounding the central cluster of figures.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and orange logo outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue with high value whites for a luminous, ethereal effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, stylized block letters with sharp, lightning-like extensions.
letterConstructionRules: Horizontal bars extend into jagged, electric bolts
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' and 'L' feature elongated horizontal strokes that frame the word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly stylized custom logo paired with clean, sans-serif secondary text and vertical Japanese typesetting on the OBI.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the jagged, electric energy of the original logo.
Suitable for the bold, condensed secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical image of five figures in white clothing reflected across a horizontal center line against a blue sky with clouds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom jagged logo at the top center and its 180-degree rotation at the bottom center. Add a vertical white strip on the left with black text.

verificationChecks: Is the image perfectly symmetrical across the horizontal axis?
Is the logo mirrored at the top and bottom?
Is the background a clear blue sky with soft clouds?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the lineup
Length of the lightning bolt extensions on the logo
mustRedesign: Exact Japanese text on the OBI strip
postGenerationChecks: Verify the logo is legible in both orientations
Ensure the OBI strip does not obscure the main subject
Confirm the color palette is limited to blue, white, and gold
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical reflection + Blue sky backdrop + Jagged custom lettering = Celestial Rock Aesthetic
